turns.message: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
turns.response:
If your Getnet card machine won't connect to the internet, follow these steps depending on your connection type:

**If you are using Wi-Fi:**
1. Make sure your Wi-Fi router is working properly and that you have the correct password (Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-configuracoes/como-configurar-o-wi-fi-na-sua-maquininha-getnet/, collected on 07/11/2026).
2. On the main screen of your terminal, tap **"Wi-Fi"** (Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-configuracoes/como-configurar-o-wi-fi-na-sua-maquininha-getnet/, collected on 07/11/2026).
3. Select **"Search Networks"** to view available connections (Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-configuracoes/como-configurar-o-wi-fi-na-sua-maquininha-getnet/, collected on 07/11/2026).
4. Find and select your network name, carefully type the password, and confirm (Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-configuracoes/como-configurar-o-wi-fi-na-sua-maquininha-getnet/, collected on 07/11/2026).

**If you are experiencing signal issues or communication errors (such as errors ADQ 1-18, ADQ 1-84, or ADQ 1-87):**
1. Ensure the SIM card is properly inserted into the terminal (Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-erros-maquininha/erro-adq-1-87/, collected on 20/11/2026).
2. Press the **Function** key on the keypad (Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-erros-maquininha/erro-adq-1-87/, collected on 20/11/2026).
3. Enter **25** (the screen will turn green to confirm) (Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-erros-maquininha/erro-adq-1-87/, collected on 20/11/2026).
4. Enter your **Merchant or Operator Password** (the screen will turn green to confirm) (Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-erros-maquininha/erro-adq-1-87/, collected on 20/11/2026).
5. Select **Function 46** (the screen will turn green to confirm) (Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-erros-maquininha/erro-adq-1-87/, collected on 20/11/2026).
6. If applicable to your error, select **Function 90** (the screen will turn green to confirm again) (Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-erros-maquininha/erro-adq-1-87/, collected on 20/11/2026).
7. Run a test sale (Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-erros-maquininha/erro-adq-1-87/, collected on 20/11/2026).

turns.response:
With Getnet, you can advance the payment of your credit card sales (both single-payment and installments) using the Getnet Brasil mobile app (available for Android and iOS) or the Minha Conta portal. There are two main options:

1. **Spot Advance (Pontual):**
- Log in to the Getnet Brasil app.
- Go to the **Services** menu and select **Sales Advance (Antecipação de Vendas)**.
- Choose the registered bank account where you want to receive the funds.
- Read and accept the terms.
- Simulate the advance, checking the amounts, card brands, and fees, then click confirm.
- Review the final amount and click **Advance**.
- Enter your password to complete the request (you can track the status in the "My Orders" area).
*Note:* The minimum amount for an advance is R$ 50,00.

2. **Automatic Advance:**
You can enable or disable automatic advances directly through the Getnet Brasil app (requires an administrator profile and password). Enabling takes up to 48 hours, and to complete an advance, you must have a minimum balance of R$ 50,00.

turns.message: Minha maquininha não conecta na internet, o que eu faço?
turns.response:
Para resolver problemas de conexão na sua maquininha, o procedimento depende se você está usando o chip de dados ou o Wi-Fi:

### Se o problema for de sinal (chip) ou falha de comunicação:
1. Pressione a tecla **Função** na maquininha.
2. Digite **25** (a tela ficará verde confirmando).
3. Insira a **Senha do Operador** (a tela ficará verde confirmando).
4. Selecione a **Função 46** (a tela ficará verde confirmando).
5. Realize uma venda de teste para verificar se o sinal restabeleceu.

Se persistir com erros específicos de processamento, você também pode tentar:
1. Pressione a tecla **Função**.
2. Digite **59** (a tela ficará verde confirmando).
3. Selecione a **Função 25** (a tela ficará verde confirmando).
4. Insira a **Senha do Operador** (a tela ficará verde confirmando).
5. Selecione a **Função 46** (a tela ficará verde confirmando).
6. Faça uma venda de teste.
*(Fontes: [Erro ADQ 1-84](https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-erros-maquininha/erro-adq-1-84/), [Erro ADQ 1-18](https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-erros-maquininha/erro-adq-1-18/), [Erro ADQ 1-19](https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-erros-maquininha/erro-adq-1-19/) e [Erro ADQ 1-85](https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-erros-maquininha/erro-adq-1-85/) - consultadas em 20/11/2026).*

---

### Se você estiver tentando conectar ao Wi-Fi:
1. Acesse a opção de **Wi-Fi** na tela inicial da sua maquininha.
2. Selecione **“Procurar Redes”** para listar as redes disponíveis.
3. Escolha o nome da sua rede de internet e selecione-a.
4. Digite a senha da sua rede e confirme.
*(Fonte: [Como configurar o Wi-Fi na sua maquininha Getnet](https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-configuracoes/como-configurar-o-wi-fi-na-sua-maquininha-getnet/) - consultada em 07/11/2026).*
